name: hogarplus
description: HogarPlus — plataforma de venta por catálogo a crédito

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hogarplus/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hogarplus/api" "npm run dev -w @hogarplus/web"
scripts.build:railway: npm run build -w @hogarplus/shared && npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w @hogarplus/api && npm run build -w @hogarplus/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hogarplus/shared && npm run build -w @hogarplus/api && npm run build -w @hogarplus/web
